The '''Min Min Heights''' were a [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] range located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro]]. It was only approachable on foot, and was impassable by ground vehicles. Even [[Starship/Legends|starships]] could not find suitable clearance to land. The area was riddled with alcoves and small caves, and there was a magnificent view of the [[Doaba Badlands]] and the [[Socorran]] skyline. The Min Min Heights got their name from the [[Min Min lights]], a light phenomena that appeared in the late dawn and early dusk.<ref name="BSS" />
